thread:
Alex Chen: Hey team — POC kickoff for NovaPayments. They asked for a quick package: SOC2 summary, ISO cert copy, a signed pen-test attestation (vendor letter), a simple network diagram, and confirmation on whether we can provide staging creds for a short window. Also they want clarity on any additional costs for audit support during procurement. Can security and SE confirm what's shareable and turnaround?
Maria Gomez: Timeline note — procurement wants these artifacts by next Tue 09:00 UTC to keep the procurement slot. Can we hit that?
Samir Patel: Security here — we have a SOC2 summary and controls matrix we can share immediately. ISO cert (PDF) is available from the registry, can redact sensitive metadata. Pen-test attestation: we can produce a signed letter referencing the last third-party engagement, but legal needs to sign off before it goes out. ETA: 2-3 business days for signed version.
Jessie Lee: SE — for the POC we can create a scoped staging tenant and issue temporary creds. Requirements: customer public IPs for allowlist, SSO invite (if they want SAML) or short-lived API key otherwise. If they request full on-prem package or a private VPC, that’s a separate quoting item (setup + monthly). Ballpark for private POC infra: $25k one-time onboarding + $3k/mo.
Alex Chen: @Samir can you stage what we can share into an evidence bucket and post a link? @Jessie can you draft the staging creds template + minimal runbook? I’ll sync pricing with finance.
Assurance Bot: Uploaded artifacts to evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/novapay/1767894321/ — access granted to nova-payments@novapay.com :package: (contains: SOC2-summary.pdf, controls-matrix.csv, ISO-certificate.pdf (redacted), pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf)
Samir Patel: Link confirmed. Note: pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf is unsigned and references the vendor report; legal sign required. Also removed internal IP ranges from the network doc.
Jessie Lee: Network diagram (minimal) — paste below for customer preview:
```
- External LB (TLS) -> Edge FW -> VPC peering -> Dedicated GPU pool (private subnets)
- KV cache and prefix caching inside private subnet
- Optional: Customer VPN to peering VPC for data-in-flight control
```
Samir Patel: For staging creds we recommend a 7-day window and strict rate limits + read-only audit logs. We should require their admin SSO user to be invited rather than sharing long-lived keys.
Maria Gomez: Quick pricing Q from procurement: is audit assistance (answering auditor questions, pulling logs, short Q&A calls) billable for POC customers?
Alex Chen: Yes — propose an 'audit assist' add-on: flat $2k for up to 8 hours of SE/security time, then $200/hr after. This covers artifact assembly and up to two 1-hr calls with auditors. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: Sounds reasonable. Legal: please review language for the pen-test attestation and any liability callouts.
Legal Bot: @Samir Once you upload the finalized attestation PDF with the vendor stamp, I can sign and return. If the customer needs additional indemnities we should escalate to contracts.
Jessie Lee: I'll prepare the staging creds template and a one-page runbook (how to connect, allowed ports, expected traffic profile) and drop it in the same bucket by EOD Friday.
Maria Gomez: I'll send the procurement checklist and timeline to the customer this afternoon and request their NAT/public IPs for allowlisting.
Alex Chen: TL;DR next steps: Samir finalizes signed pen-test letter (Fri EOD ideally), Jessie posts runbook + staging creds (Fri EOD), Maria requests IPs and confirms procurement deadline with customer (tomorrow). Pricing: include the $2k audit assist add-on in the quote. Thanks all :thumbsup:
